Chapter 310: Chapter 12: Which Peak Master Has Advanced To The Seventh Rank? (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 310: Chapter 12: Which Peak Master Has Advanced to the Seventh Rank? (Subscribe Please)

“Is the junior disciple about to break through to the Seventh Rank?”

This was the first thought that surfaced in the minds of the twelve Peak Masters.

An Evolver breaking through a great realm is like a pebble falling into water, creating ripples.

Ordinary people or weaker Evolvers might not notice.

But it can’t be hidden from Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers.

When Lin Yuan first stepped into the Sixth Rank on Canglan Star, the noise of his breakthrough was captured by the Great Senior Brother and the Demon Rat Clan Monarch.

...

Thus, the twelve Peak Masters instantly felt the aura of a breakthrough to the Seventh Rank emanating from Chikun Main Star.

And they confirmed that the aura of the breakthrough originated from the Thirteen Peaks.

From this, they concluded that the junior disciple was breaking through.

“How much time has passed?”

This was the second thought that emerged in the minds of the twelve Peak Masters.

Advancing from the Sixth Rank to the Seventh Rank is no easy matter,

This is a major threshold, a major constraint, Peak Masters Four through Twelve are still trapped at the peak of the Sixth Rank.

One can see the difficulty in this.

In the minds of these nine Sixth Rank Peak Masters, Lin Yuan had terrifying potential and indeed had a better chance than them of entering the Seventh Rank in the future.

But that would require time, right?

How long has it been since Lin Yuan broke through the Sixth Rank?

This is simply unreasonable.

“Junior disciple?”

The Great Peak Master blinked his eyes.

Not long ago, one of his avatars personally guarded Canglan Star and witnessed the entire process of Lin Yuan’s advancement to the Sixth Rank.

What the Great Peak Master did not expect, however, was that he would witness his junior disciple advancing from the Sixth Rank to the Seventh Rank today.

“Teacher, did you already know the junior disciple was about to break through?”

Fourth Peak Master Zuo Ge swallowed nervously and asked cautiously.

This time, the Chikun Star Lord specifically called them out, not disturbing Lin Yuan, which now seemed quite prescient.

Perhaps he already knew something.

“Naturally.”

The Chikun Star Lord glanced at his several disciples.

Previously, Lin Yuan had consulted him about the basic space models, and the Chikun Star Lord realized that Lin Yuan’s understanding of Space Rules was terrifyingly high, not at all like an Evolver who had just entered the Sixth Rank.

Such high comprehension of space meant that Lin Yuan’s realm far exceeded the Sixth Rank, plus as a Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage with an unlimited supply of “Scarlet Spirit Liquid,” there was no need to slowly accumulate energy.

Under many factors,

The Chikun Star Lord felt that Lin Yuan advancing to the Seventh Rank was completely to be expected.

Only, even the Chikun Star Lord did not expect that Lin Yuan would choose to break through so quickly?

Not continue to accumulate?

Or consult him about the details of advancing to the Seventh Rank?

Of course,

Although the Chikun Star Lord hadn’t interacted much with Lin Yuan,

Based on his understanding of Lin Yuan, he knew his junior disciple was steady-minded and would not act without assurance. Even when suppressed by the Heiyu Family in the past, he hadn’t revealed his identity.

Now that he has chosen to break through to the Seventh Rank, he surely has ample confidence.

“What is this cultivation speed of the junior disciple?”

“I’m still rotating in the Sixth Rank, and the junior disciple has reached the Seventh Rank?”

“Isn’t the junior disciple still under thirty? A Seventh Rank at thirty?”

“When I was thirty, I was still playing around in the Fourth and Fifth Ranks…”

…

After regaining their composure, the twelve Peak Masters spoke in astonished tones and quickly started discussing.

The stronger the strength, the more they could understand how terrifying Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed truly was.

In the long history of the Chikun Star Domain and even the entire Annan Star Alliance, there had been Seventh Rank Evolvers under thirty.

But most of these Evolvers had many opportunities and had entered the Sixth Rank very early, spending ten to nearly twenty years before breaking through to the Seventh Rank.

To advance like Lin Yuan, entering the Sixth Rank less than two years ago and then advancing to the Seventh Rank, there probably aren’t many such instances in the entire history of human civilization, are there?

“Currently, in the overt records of the Human Civilization Alliance, among Evolvers who reached the Seventh Rank before thirty, ten percent remain at the Seventh Rank, twenty percent die in various accidents, and seventy percent reach the Eighth Rank, which means, as long as the junior disciple doesn’t die, reaching the Eighth Rank is almost inevitable.”

Second Senior Brother muttered to himself, still somewhat in disbelief.

Setting aside other factors, just this terrifying cultivation speed alone will ensure Lin Yuan a prominent place in the annals of human civilization.

In the future, even millions or tens of millions of years later, when Evolvers mention a Seventh Rank under the age of thirty, Lin Yuan will undoubtedly be cited.

Such a brilliant and outstanding Evolver, and he’s actually their junior disciple?

“Alright.”

“Enough talking.”

“Just watch carefully and feel, this chance doesn’t come often.”

The Chikun Star Lord glanced again at the various Peak Masters and spoke.

“Yes.”

The twelve Peak Masters immediately stopped discussing.

Especially the Fourth to Twelfth Peak Masters, they observed even more intently.

Advancing from the Sixth Rank to the Seventh Rank begins to impact the cosmic starry sky; this subtle change has a slight stimulating effect on those Evolvers at the peak of the Sixth Rank.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Deep within the Thirteen Peaks Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

At this moment, his internal energy was boiling to the extreme.

With just a single thought, he could step into the Seventh Rank.

“Next, I need to integrate the way of Taiyin and Taiyang with the Dao of Space to evolve a Taiji microcosm…”

Lin Yuan sat there, the Power of Taiyin and Taiyang within his Qi Sea Dantian continuously colliding, emitting an indescribable aura.

If Lin Yuan hadn’t mastered nine hundred sixty-five basic space models, at this moment inside his Qi Sea Dantian, he would stop progressing.

In terms of the sheer depth and suppressive power of the pure domain, he might be much stronger than other Seventh Rank Evolvers, but he would still be on the same level, nowhere comparible to an Eighth Rank Evolver.

But now?

“Space…”

Lin Yuan’s mind flickered slightly.

Streams of Space Power emerged from within his Qi Sea Dantian.
